newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Northbrook, Ill..

text.p: SEALED Bids will be received by the Village of Northbrook, Illinois in the office of the Village's financial advisor at First Chicago Capital Markets, November 12, 1996 at 11:00 a.m. (Central Standard Time) for the purchase of the Bonds of the Village dated December 1, 1996 and due on December 1 of the following years and in the following amounts:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Village intends to designate the Bonds qualified tax- exempt obligations '' for the purpose of permitting the deduction of carrying costs by banks and financial
institutions. The Bonds will be issued in book-entry-only form, through Depository Trust Company (

registered Bonds in the amount of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Village in accordance with the terms set forth in the Official Notice of Sale. The Village will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Katten Muchin & Zavis, Chicago, Illinois.
